title: Desk Guidance on Order Cancellation and Cancellation Credits, Ridgeline Orders & Delivery
content:
A Ridgeline Orders & Delivery order may be cancelled by the customer, by their own confirmation, while its status is placed, or ready but not yet dispatched or picked up, where the program permits the customer to cancel before the order is ready. Once the order is out for delivery it can only be refused at the door or returned.

## What the customer may cancel

| Order status in the order record | Cancellation by the customer |
|---|---|
| Placed | Open, by the customer's own confirmation, where the program permits cancellation before the order is ready |
| Ready, not yet dispatched and not yet picked up | Open on the same terms |
| Out for delivery | Not open; the order can only be refused at the door or returned |

## What a cancellation books

On cancellation:

1. the order total is reversed by an order cancellation credit;
2. the delivery charge is refunded as a delivery fee refund credit, but only where the program refunds the delivery charge on cancellation; under a program that does not, no delivery fee refund credit is booked;
3. every payment on the order is refunded to the tender it was paid with.

The order's status becomes cancelled, and the cancellation date and the reason for it are recorded on the order.

## Cancellations made by the system

The system cancels:

- a pickup order not collected by its pickup deadline date, the last day of its hold;
- an order whose failed delivery attempts reach the program's limit of failed attempts; the redelivery fees on such an order are not refunded;
- an order whose item stays on backorder more than the program's backorder days past the promised date.

The order record shows which of these, or a cancellation by the customer, was the reason.

## Points of judgement (illustrative)

- An order placed this morning and still in placed status: the customer may cancel it by their own confirmation.
- A pickup order that is ready and has not been picked up: the customer may still cancel it.
- A truck delivery shown as out for delivery: it cannot be cancelled; it can only be refused at the door or returned.
- A cancelled order under a program that refunds the delivery charge on cancellation receives both an order cancellation credit and a delivery fee refund credit; under a program that does not, only the order cancellation credit.
- An order cancelled by the system after its failed attempts reached the limit keeps its redelivery fees.
